name: Xbox Game Pass

fastest.text: Sign in at account.microsoft.com/services, find Game Pass and choose Cancel subscription or Turn off recurring billing.

steps: Sign in at account.microsoft.com/services with the Microsoft account that pays.
Find your Game Pass subscription and select Manage.
Choose Cancel subscription, or Turn off recurring billing to keep playing until your paid time runs out.
Confirm, and look for Microsoft's confirmation email.
note: Bought Game Pass with a prepaid code from a store? There's nothing to cancel; it simply runs out, and refunds follow that store's policy.

faq.q: Can I cancel on my Xbox?
faq.a: Yes. Go to Settings → Account → Subscriptions, pick Game Pass, then choose Cancel or Turn off recurring billing.

faq.q: Do I lose access right away?
faq.a: Not if you turn off recurring billing: you keep Game Pass until the time you've paid for runs out, and it isn't renewed.
PC Game Pass is {price:PC Game Pass} in the US if you only play on PC.
